name: Second Kiss Engine AP OLD
description: Exposed clockwork gears spin at high speeds.
disable: DC 28 Thievery (expert) to disable the engine, or engineering-lore|dc:26|name:Disengage the drive shaft to disengage the drive shaft. Either method disables the trap but also shuts down the engine, disabling the Second Kiss's propulsion.

generalAbilities.name: Spinning Gears
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature Strides in the engine nacelle

Effect The creature's clothing or limbs get caught in the spinning gears and axles of the engine. The creature must attempt a DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes (2d8+9) Bludgeoning Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes (4d8+18) Bludgeoning Damage damage.

Critical Failure The creature's clothing is pulled into the clockworks. The creature takes (4d8+18) Bludgeoning Damage damage and is Restrained. Until the creature Escapes, it takes (2d8+9) Bludgeoning Damage damage each round as it's pulled into the spinning rotors. A creature wearing clothing can automatically Escape by doffing its caught clothing; this destroys the doffed clothing.
